nodes.description: Private owner address set in the constructor; sole authority for init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of allowances written by approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping counting per-address sales, incremented unchecked in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private whitelist mapping checked inside ensure to bypass sale restrictions.
Minimum sale amount configured by init and enforced by condition.
Maximum sale amount configured by init and enforced by condition.
Maximum number of sales per address configured by init and enforced by condition.
Whitelisted trade address set by setTradeAddress and honoured by ensure.
Total token supply fixed in the constructor.
Constant 18 used when scaling supply and init limits.
Token name assigned in the constructor.
Token symbol assigned in the constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router constant whitelisted in ensure and pre-approved in the constructor.
Payable external transfer that immediately delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist/limit gate: returns true for owner, router, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise requires the sale condition.
Payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum with raw arithmetic and no reentrancy guard.
Payable approval that blindly sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to the caller supplied value.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits; returns false when limits are unset.
Owner-only payable function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with caller supplied calldata b.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using unchecked scaling multiplication.
Owner-only payable batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath and credits each recipient.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation used by ensure to whitelist the token pair.
Payable constructor that sets name/symbol/supply, assigns owner = msg.sender and pre-approves the router with uint(-1).
Caller controlled address used for authorization checks, transfers, approvals and owner assignment.
Raw delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata, executed in the token's storage context.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length allowing integer overflow that understates the transferred total.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in the batch loop allowing balance overflow.
Per-recipient amount argument of batchSend, feeds the overflow-prone total computation.
Recipient array argument of batchSend whose length multiplicates _value unchecked.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow protection.
Loop index over the recipient array in batchSend.
Amount argument of transferFrom verified against allowance and balance with raw subtraction.
Debit address of transferFrom, also the key incremented in _onSaleNum.
Amount argument of transfer forwarded verbatim to transferFrom.
Recipient argument of transfer forwarded verbatim to transferFrom.
Target address of the owner-only arbitrary delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Sale count limit configured by the owner in init.
New whitelisted trade address supplied by the owner.
Sender address inspected by the ensure whitelist and forwarded to condition.
Transfer amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
First token of the pair whose address is derived in pairFor.
Second token of the pair whose address is derived in pairFor.
